items.criterion: The health route answers 200 with no credential once the app has seeded.
items.judgment: Read the status of the unauthenticated health call.

items.criterion: Signing in with a seeded address returns an access_token and the role recorded on the account.
items.judgment: Read the login response body.

items.criterion: A wrong password is never served a token.
items.judgment: Read the status of the failed login.

items.criterion: The identity surface reports the role and the program held on the account row.
items.judgment: Compare the response with the stored account row.

items.criterion: The public catalogue is a top-level array that excludes the deprecated course.
items.judgment: Read the catalogue body.

items.criterion: A reader page carries its position counters.
items.judgment: Read the page body for the four counter fields.

items.criterion: One page_progress row exists per account and page however often completion is sent.
items.judgment: Count the stored rows before and after a repeat.

items.criterion: A completed page never returns to in_progress.
items.judgment: Read the stored status after a late write.

items.criterion: A free enrolment records entitlement_source free.
items.judgment: Read the stored enrolment row.

items.criterion: A funded enrolment reserves the course price and counts one seat.
items.judgment: Compare the program row before and after.

items.criterion: One enrolment row exists per account and course.
items.judgment: Count the stored rows after a repeat enrolment.

items.criterion: An enrolment records the program that funded it.
items.judgment: Read program_id on the stored enrolment.

items.criterion: An assessment opens in PreAssessment once every page of the module is complete.
items.judgment: Read the stored assessment row.

items.criterion: An exam start with any consent false is refused.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged assessment row.

items.criterion: The exam end time is the server's own and never the client's.
items.judgment: Read ends_at from the response.

items.criterion: No served question carries an answer key.
items.judgment: Scan the exam response body.

items.criterion: A proctor event persists with a kind from the pinned set.
items.judgment: Read the stored proctor_event rows.

items.criterion: Three face signals in one attempt mark the exam Suspicious.
items.judgment: Read the stored exam status.

items.criterion: A submission records a result and moves the assessment on.
items.judgment: Read the submit response body.

items.criterion: A project submission missing an address writes no row.
items.judgment: Count the stored project rows.

items.criterion: The seeded catalogue carries the pinned chain and course shape.
items.judgment: Read the stored chain and course rows.

items.criterion: The seeded programs carry the pinned treasury, reward and bounty shape.
items.judgment: Read the stored program, reward and bounty rows.

items.criterion: A cookie choice survives a fresh sign-in.
items.judgment: Read the choice back on a new session.

items.criterion: One page_view row exists per recorded view.
items.judgment: Count the stored rows before and after.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous funded enrolments leave the treasury whole.
items.judgment: Read treasury_remaining after the race.

items.criterion: The treasury burn reconciles with the funded enrolments drawn against it.
items.judgment: Compare the program row with its enrolments.

items.criterion: Issuance appends exactly one ledger row for the credential.
items.judgment: Count the stored issuance rows.

items.criterion: A repeat issuance writes no second ledger row.
items.judgment: Count the ledger rows before and after.

items.criterion: A revocation appends a row and leaves the issuance row unchanged.
items.judgment: Compare the issuance row before and after.

items.criterion: The reward quota is never oversold under contention.
items.judgment: Count the stored reward_earn rows.

items.criterion: Audit rows are append only and carry their chain fields.
items.judgment: Compare the stored rows across two reads.

items.criterion: The catalogue pages by cursor within the pinned page size.
items.judgment: Read the page length and the cursor header.

items.criterion: A replayed idempotent enrolment stores one row.
items.judgment: Count the stored enrolment rows.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated enrolment is denied and writes nothing.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged row count.

items.criterion: A learner issuance attempt is denied and the credential row is untouched.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged row count.

items.criterion: A reviewer issuance attempt is denied.
items.judgment: Read the status of the reviewer call.

items.criterion: A learner cannot create a partner program.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged program row.

items.criterion: A learner approving their own project is denied and the project stays InReview.
items.judgment: Read the status and the stored project row.

items.criterion: A reviewer of another program is refused on the project.
items.judgment: Read the status and the stored project row.

items.criterion: A learner never sees another learner's project in a listing.
items.judgment: Read the project listing body.

items.criterion: A program-restricted course is denied outside its program.
items.judgment: Read the status and the entitlement flag.

items.criterion: A program-restricted course is readable inside its own program.
items.judgment: Read the status of the in-program call.

items.criterion: A paywalled body is served to nobody without entitlement.
items.judgment: Read the page body for the unentitled account.

items.criterion: A role claimed in a request body changes nothing.
items.judgment: Read the identity response and the stored account row.

items.criterion: A program roster carries no contact detail.
items.judgment: Scan the roster response body.

items.criterion: A bounty gated on a credential refuses an account holding none.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged application count.

items.criterion: A credential proof address resolves for a caller with no token.
items.judgment: Read the proof response body.

items.criterion: An unknown ledger reference is reported as not found.
items.judgment: Read the status of the unknown reference.

items.criterion: Issuance against an unfinished assessment is refused.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged credential count.

items.criterion: A transition the machine disallows changes nothing.
items.judgment: Read the stored assessment row after the attempt.

items.criterion: An invalid enrolment body is refused and writes nothing.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged row count.

items.criterion: Enrolment in a deprecated course is refused.
items.judgment: Read the status and the unchanged row count.

items.criterion: A mutating response carries the three rate-limit headers.
items.judgment: Read the response headers.

items.criterion: An erasure request is stored with its grace window.
items.judgment: Read the stored erasure_request row.

items.criterion: An enrolment records the reward window end date.
items.judgment: Read the stored enrolment row.

items.criterion: An address that was never seeded is not served a token.
items.judgment: Read the status of the unseeded login.

items.criterion: The seeded exam carries three questions at the pinned mark.
items.judgment: Read the stored exam_question rows.
